title: ide-es spawn schema
description: Contract 2 (Factory + OCP). A consumer seeds this; Scroll's create_ide_es spawns a single-person, gradable code surface. Scroll owns spawning, hosting, and grading; the consumer owns seeding. The graded oracle (hidden tests + TLE) is native to Scroll and never consumer-controllable at apply time (contract 4).

problem.description: The statement the user works against.

entry.description: The solution seam the grader invokes.

tests.description: Sample and hidden test cases. At least one must be hidden — the hidden set is the graded oracle. The TLE-gating adversarial case is a hidden test with a large input.

tleBudgetMs.description: Per-test wall-clock budget. Enforces 'use the efficient strategy': an adversarial input a brute-force blows but the intended structure clears.

complexityBudget.description: Optional informational target, e.g. 'O(n log n)'. Not machine-enforced; tleBudgetMs is the gate.

resultCallbackUrl.description: Contract 6. Opaque consumer-supplied http(s) URL; on submit Scroll POSTs the ResultPayload fire-and-forget (correlation must be baked in by the consumer, since the endpoint id is browser-minted).
